exactText:
Our forecast is up!!! It gives Joe Biden a 71% chance of winning and Donald Trump a 29% chance.
https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/2020-election-forecast/
sourceQuote: It gives Joe Biden a 71% chance of winning and Donald Trump a 29% chance.
normalizedClaim: Joe Biden has a 71% chance of winning the 2020 U.S. presidential election.
resolutionCriteria: Official Electoral College results certified by Congress / National Archives for the 2020 presidential election.

resolution.explanation: Joe Biden won the Electoral College 306-232 and the popular vote.

exactText: Still, even making what we think are fairly conservative assumptions , our final forecast has Biden with an 89 percent chance of winning the Electoral College , as compared to a 10 percent chance for Trump.
sourceQuote: our final forecast has Biden with an 89 percent chance of winning the Electoral College , as compared to a 10 percent chance for Trump.
normalizedClaim: Joe Biden has an 89% chance of winning the Electoral College in the 2020 U.S. presidential election.
resolutionCriteria: Official Electoral College results certified by Congress / National Archives for the 2020 presidential election.

resolution.explanation: Joe Biden won the Electoral College 306-232.

exactText:
Our forecast is out! Republicans are heavy favorites to win the House, but the Senate is a toss-up.
https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/2022-election-forecast/
sourceQuote: Republicans are heavy favorites to win the House, but the Senate is a toss-up.
normalizedClaim: Republicans are heavy favorites to win control of the U.S. House of Representatives in the 2022 midterms; the Senate is a toss-up.
resolutionCriteria: Official results certified by state election authorities and the Clerk of the House for the 2022 midterm elections (House majority = 218 seats).

resolution.explanation: Republicans won a narrow House majority (222-213); Democrats retained the Senate 51-49.

exactText: FiveThirtyEight’s Deluxe forecast for the U.S. House , which is now final and no longer updating, estimates that Republicans have an 84-in-100 chance of taking control of the chamber.
sourceQuote: Republicans have an 84-in-100 chance of taking control of the chamber.
normalizedClaim: Republicans have an 84% chance of winning control of the U.S. House in the 2022 midterms.
resolutionCriteria: Official results certified by state election authorities and the Clerk of the House for the 2022 midterm elections (House majority = 218 seats).

resolution.explanation: Republicans secured a House majority with 222 seats.

exactText: Out of 80,000 simulations, Kamala Harris won in 40,012 (50.015%) cases. She did not win in 39,988 simulations (49.985%).
sourceQuote: Kamala Harris won in 40,012 (50.015%) cases. She did not win in 39,988 simulations (49.985%).
normalizedClaim: Kamala Harris has a 50.015% chance of winning the Electoral College in the 2024 U.S. presidential election.
resolutionCriteria: Official Electoral College results certified by Congress / National Archives for the 2024 presidential election.

resolution.explanation: Donald Trump won the Electoral College and the popular vote; Harris did not win.

exactText: When I say the odds in this year’s presidential race are about as close as you can possibly get to 50/50, I’m not exaggerating.
sourceQuote: the odds in this year’s presidential race are about as close as you can possibly get to 50/50
normalizedClaim: The 2024 U.S. presidential election is essentially a 50/50 toss-up between Harris and Trump.
resolutionCriteria: Official Electoral College results certified by Congress / National Archives for the 2024 presidential election.

resolution.explanation: Donald Trump won both the popular vote and Electoral College; the outcome was not a near-tie in result.

exactText: When the model was finally done on Sunday night, it turned out that Trump was favored by a slightly larger degree than I’d anticipated at Manifest — although Biden retains highly viable paths to victory.
sourceQuote: Trump was favored by a slightly larger degree than I’d anticipated at Manifest
normalizedClaim: Donald Trump is favored over Joe Biden in the 2024 U.S. presidential election (model showed ~66% Trump).
resolutionCriteria: Official Electoral College results certified by Congress / National Archives for the 2024 presidential election (Biden later withdrew; claim assessed on Trump victory).

resolution.explanation: Donald Trump won the 2024 presidential election.

exactText:
The final Model Talk of the campaign is published! I’ll finally give you my “real” prediction, which, by sheer coincidence, almost exactly matches the election model I’ve spent several thousand hours designing.
See you tonight/tomorrow.
https://www.natesilver.net/p/a-random-number-generator-determined
